app.name: DocuLens
app.preview_mode: Browser preview mode (no Tauri · mock backend)

theme.preview_body: Body text, secondary text and the accent colour look like this.

desc.light: Light background for ordinary office lighting
desc.high-contrast: WCAG AAA contrast, follows Windows high-contrast mode

palette.placeholder: Type a command or search a screen (e.g. /theme dark, open settings)

palette.redo_started: Redo started as a job (see Jobs).

onboarding.title: Welcome to DocuLens
onboarding.subtitle: Three steps and you are ready. Everything stays on this PC.

workspace.intro: Choose the folder that will hold your documents and inference data. A .doculens/ directory is created inside it and models are stored there too (portable).
workspace.inspect_new: A new workspace will be created.
workspace.inspect_documents: Found {{count}} document file(s). You can import them right after opening the workspace.
workspace.inspect_missing: The folder does not exist yet. 'Create and open' will create it.
workspace.inspect_unsafe: A drive root or the home folder cannot be used as a workspace.
workspace.inspect_locked: Another instance (pid {{pid}} on {{host}}) is using this workspace.
workspace.inspect_stale: A lock file from a previous run was found. It will be recovered automatically.
workspace.browser_hint: In the browser preview there is no native folder picker; type a path instead.
workspace.settings_sync: The path is stored as active_workspace in settings.json and can be changed under Settings › Workspace.

hardware.intro: The detected hardware decides the tier and the recommended model. You can override both in the model manager at any time.

model.intro: Classification, OCR and extraction need a VLM (GGUF + mmproj). You can skip this now; import, search and organizing work without a model.
model.download_desc: Fetched from Hugging Face when online and verified with SHA-256.
model.import_desc: Drop GGUF + mmproj files fetched on another PC into the workspace model folder; they are registered automatically (drop-in folder).
model.later_desc: Start without a model. You can prepare one in the model manager any time.
model.required_files_hint: Copy file names, sizes, SHA-256 and URLs as text to download them on another PC.
model.installed: Installed — you can start right away.

warn.cpu_only_slow: No usable GPU: running on the CPU. OCR may take 2–4 minutes per page.
warn.no_nvml: NVIDIA driver (NVML) not found. AMD/Intel GPUs are supported through the Vulkan backend (P1).
warn.low_ram: Less than 8 GB of RAM. Large documents may process slowly.
warn.cuda_driver_too_old: The driver's CUDA version is below 12.1. Update the driver or use the Vulkan backend.
warn.old_gpu_arch: Old GPU architecture (CC < 7.0): some kernels may be slow or unsupported.

basis.engine_free_vram: Free VRAM reported by the engine

home.stats_hint: Awaiting review / done come from the pipeline. Check low-confidence fields in the review queue.
home.command_hint: Theme, language and navigation run immediately; document commands go to the assistant (P5 planner).
home.command_placeholder: e.g. process the inbox / last month's receipt total / switch to dark mode
home.recent_empty: No documents yet. Import them in the library or drop them into inbox/.
home.command_drop: Drop documents or files to attach them in the assistant

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.placeholder: Command or ask in natural language (한국어 / English) · / for slash commands
assistant.empty: How can I help? Try one of the examples.
assistant.help_body: Natural-language commands become a plan card (steps · impact · preview) that runs after your approval. Examples: process inbox, last month's receipt total, tax invoices → Excel, move receipts into monthly folders, summarize the selected documents, undo the last rename. Instant commands: /theme dark|light|system|high-contrast, /lang ko|en, /open <screen>, /job pause, /undo. Questions are answered from the knowledge base with per-sentence sources. Ctrl+Enter approves · Esc cancels · Ctrl+Z undoes.
assistant.qa_hint: Ask a question and the assistant answers from the knowledge base with per-sentence sources.

attachments.label: Attached documents
attachments.hint: Drag library documents or drop files here: they become the scope of your questions and commands
attachments.drop: Drop documents or files to attach

memory.hint: The last turns of this conversation (up to 8) and what the screen shows (open document, selection, folder, project) travel with every question and command. 'New chat' clears them.

routing.label: Interpretation
routing.hint: Model: only slash commands and reply / cancel are handled by rules, everything else by the model (default). Rules (legacy): phrase rules first, the model only when they fail.

card.title: Plan
card.only_reviewed: Do not move documents that are not reviewed
card.invalid: The plan cannot run. Edit it and try again.
card.impact_draft: {{count}} document draft(s) (saved on the generate screen)
card.retention_shorter: The retention period gets shorter — expired data is deleted by the next purge run.
card.ask_back_placeholder: Ask about this plan or say what to change

execution.title: Running · job #{{id}}
execution.gate_notice: Interactive requests are handled at the next page boundary (≈{{seconds}}s)
execution.job_missing: The job is no longer in the job book.

aggregate.title: Aggregate — {{summary}}
aggregate.evidence: Evidence: the '{{field}}' field of each document

clarify.title: Clarification
clarify.fallback: What would you like to do? Please be a little more specific.
clarify.no_model: The planner model is not loaded, so the sentence cannot be interpreted. Load a model or switch the interpretation above to 'rules'.
clarify.retry_hint: Reply and Cancel act at once; every other sentence is read by the model.
clarify.reply_placeholder: Answer the question or ask back

ui.define_schema: Create the schema on the schema screen from '{{description}}'.
ui.register_form: Form registration of '{{name}}' started (confirm the field grid).

models.title: Model manager

import.title: Import GGUF

models.no_workspace: Open a workspace to see installation status.
models.drop_in_hint: Put GGUF + mmproj files into a sub-folder here: they are detected, verified and registered automatically. The import button is a convenience that copies into the same folder.

models.download_hint: Fetched from Hugging Face and verified with SHA-256.
models.download_disabled: Online downloads are disabled in settings.
models.download_started: Download started. Follow the progress on the Jobs screen.
models.delete_confirm: Delete the folder '{{folder}}' and the model files in it? This cannot be undone.

actions.hash_hint: Computes SHA-256/BLAKE3 and compares with the registry pins (takes minutes).

discovered.title: Model folder (drop-in)
discovered.empty: No GGUF files in the model folder yet. Import or download a model.

engine_card.install_hint: Install it under engines\<version>\<pack>\ with the script in engines/README.md, or point to a binary below.
engine_card.auto_start: Start automatically when a workspace opens
engine_card.vision_cpu: Audit mode (vision encoder on the CPU)

test.title: Model test
test.stats: {{tokens}} output tokens · {{prompt}} prompt tokens · {{ms}} ms · {{tps}} tok/s

general.language_hint: Korean is the default for the UI and commands; English works too.
general.scale_hint: 90–150 %. Also Ctrl+Shift+(+/−). Independent of the Windows DPI setting.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: The choice is stored in settings.json and applied to the window title bar. Document images are never inverted in dark mode.

workspace.settings_file_hint: Editing active_workspace by hand is picked up on the next start. A missing path leads to onboarding.

processing.review_threshold_hint: Fields below this confidence go to the review queue.

processing.kie_max_pages_hint: First N−1 pages plus the last one. Raise it for long contracts.

processing.dense_cells: Table cells that make a page dense

privacy.pii_masking_hint: Resident/foreigner registration numbers and bank accounts are stored only in masked form (YYMMDD-G******); the original is never stored.
privacy.retention_hint: Stored per workspace. A daily purge job deletes expired items without the OS recycle bin and writes the counts to the audit log.
privacy.requires_workspace: Open a workspace to edit retention.

maintenance.title: Purge job
maintenance.hint: Deletes expired journal entries, job records, chats, cache and temporary data every day at the configured hour. It can also run right now.
maintenance.summary: journal {{journal}} · jobs {{jobs}} · chats {{answers}} · documents {{documents}} · extractions {{extractions}} · logs {{logs}} · temp {{temp}} · cache {{cache}} · trash {{trash}}

shortcuts.hint: Editing shortcuts arrives in a later phase. Enter is ignored while composing Korean text.

about.licenses_hint: Only licenses without a source-disclosure obligation are used (Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD / ISC / OFL …). Model weights are Apache-2.0 (Qwen3.5) and MIT (bge-m3).
about.font: Font: Pretendard Variable (OFL-1.1, unmodified file bundled)

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.hint: Defaults for chunking, indexing, embeddings and grounded answers.
knowledge.auto_index_hint: Chunks changed documents after import, rescan and re-render.
knowledge.auto_embed_hint: Embeds new chunks in the background while the embedding model is loaded.
knowledge.latest_only_hint: Superseded editions in a version group are excluded from search and answers.
knowledge.allow_general: Allow general-knowledge answers when there is no evidence
knowledge.allow_general_hint: Off by default (prevents hallucination). Such answers are labelled 'general knowledge'.
knowledge.min_similarity_hint: Chunks found only by embedding similarity count as evidence above this value (bge-m3 ≈ 0.5).

notifications.job_complete_hint: Shows an OS notification when a batch job finishes.
notifications.prevent_sleep_hint: Keeps the PC awake while jobs are running.

library.title: Document library
library.inbox_watch_hint: Files placed in inbox/ are imported automatically.
library.empty_body: Drop PDF, image, HWP, HWPX or DOCX files here or click Import. Files placed in inbox/ are registered automatically.

actions.delete_confirm: Delete {{count}} selected document(s)? Files move to the trash.

import_docs.title: Import documents
import_docs.description: Registers PDF, image, HWP, HWPX and DOCX files and renders their pages. Files outside the workspace are copied into the chosen folder.
import_docs.browser_hint: In the browser preview, type paths instead of using the file picker.

viewer.delete_confirm: Delete '{{name}}'? The file moves to the trash.
viewer.no_image: No page image. Click Re-render to create it.
viewer.tag_placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter
viewer.rotated: Rotation saved. Re-process if OCR results exist.

qa.title: Ask this document
qa.placeholder: e.g. What is the contract amount?

viewer.type_changed: Type changed. Re-extract with the new type's schema?
viewer.image_failed: The page image could not be loaded. A page purged from the cache comes back after a re-render.

text_edit.hint: Drag over the words on the image to select them, then press Enter (or 'Edit text') to correct them in place.
text_edit.edited_title: Corrected by hand — the page image itself is unchanged; this text is what search, questions and extraction use.

layer.hint: Drag over the words on the image to select them, then press Enter (or 'Edit text') to correct them in place. Corrected words are drawn in blue on white over the image (the image itself does not change). Drag over an empty area to add text.
layer.no_text: No text was recognised on this page. Run OCR with 'Process', or drag on an empty area to type the text.

layer.add_placeholder: Type the text at this spot

answer.no_evidence: No evidence was found in the knowledge base.
answer.follow_up_hint: Follow-up questions keep the same evidence. Even when off, a question that points back ('that', 'the one above') continues automatically.
answer.text_only_hint: Answered from the text you sent; no documents were looked up or cited.

search.title: Search
search.empty_hint: Morpheme (particle-aware), substring and semantic search are combined. Two-character queries work too.
search.keyword_only: The embedding model is not loaded, so these are keyword results.
search.like_fallback: Short query not in the indexes — matched by substring in the text.
search.semantic_unavailable: Install and load the embedding model (bge-m3) for semantic search.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.subtitle: Load regulations, guidelines and past documents and answer with evidence.

tokenizer.label: Tokenizer
tokenizer.simple_hint: The ko-dic dictionary was not found, so the simple tokenizer (words + bigrams) is used. Install the dictionary into the folder below (bundled with the installer, see docs/engines) to enable particle stripping and compound splitting.
tokenizer.restart_hint: Restart the app after installing the dictionary; the next index run re-chunks every document with the new analyzer.

embedding.label: Embedding model
embedding.none: The registry has no embedding model.
embedding.not_installed: The embedding model ({{model}}) is not installed; keyword search only. Install it on the Models screen.
embedding.not_loaded: The embedding model ({{model}}) is installed. Run to load it into the engine and embed the chunks.
embedding.reset_confirm: Delete all stored embeddings? They are recomputed on the next run.

actions.reindex_confirm: Re-chunk and re-index every document? Stored embeddings are cleared and recomputed.

collections.title: Collections
collections.name: Name
collections.empty: No collections yet. Use the ingest wizard to add regulations and guidelines.
collections.delete_confirm: Delete collection '{{name}}'? Its documents stay in the library.
collections.add_hint: Adds the {{count}} selected documents to a collection and marks them as knowledge documents.
collections.drop_hint: Drop documents or files to add them to this collection
collections.pending_title: Add the {{count}} dropped document(s) to a collection

wizard.title: Knowledge ingest wizard
wizard.paths_hint: Enter file or folder paths one per line, or use the pickers. Folders include their subfolders.
wizard.started: Ingest started. Import → chunking → indexing run in the background.
wizard.nothing: No new files to ingest (already registered documents are only added to the collection).

wizard.drop_hint: You can also drop files or folders here

versions.title: Document versions
versions.hint: Group editions of one title; search and answers use the latest edition by default.
versions.empty: No version groups yet. Register one from the viewer's 'Version' menu.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.hint: Terms and synonyms expand search queries (e.g. 출장비 ↔ 여비).

test.title: Question test
test.hint: Shows which evidence a question retrieves (no model call).
test.placeholder: e.g. What is the settlement deadline?

process.queued: Queued behind the running pipeline job ({{count}} document(s)).
process.no_model: Auto-processing was skipped: no vision model is loaded. Load a model on the Models screen, then press 'Process'.
process.engine_off: Auto-processing was skipped: the engine is off. Start it, or enable auto-start in Settings.
process.model_not_loaded: Vision model {{model}} is not loaded; it loads when processing starts.
process.model_none: No vision model. Install one in the Model manager.
process.confirm_body: {{count}} document(s) already have extraction results; a new run replaces them. Approvals and corrections of the previous run stay in the History tab, but the Fields tab and the review queue switch to the new results.

split.title: Split document
split.hint: A new document starts at each checked page. The original is archived; the parts are auto-processed.
split.none: Pick at least one split page (page 2 or later).

merge.title: Merge documents

merge.name: File name (optional)
merge.drop_hint: Drop documents to add them to the merge list

schemas.title: Extraction schemas / forms
schemas.subtitle: Registered forms and the built-in sample forms define document types and the fields to extract.

list.empty: No registered forms yet. Start with 'Register form' or 'Create from description'.

schemas.pending_hint: Waiting for the model. Cancelling discards the result when it arrives.

editor.name: Name (Korean)
editor.doc_type_hint: Lower-case ASCII, digits, _ (the classifier's type value)
editor.registered: Form registered. It now feeds the classifier and the extractor.
editor.delete_confirm: Delete schema '{{name}}'? Existing extractions are kept.
editor.test_hint: Extracts the chosen document with this schema (fill rate in the viewer's Fields tab).
editor.discard_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?

lint.fields_empty: A schema needs at least one field.
lint.key_reserved: value / evidence / confidence are reserved keys.
lint.label_missing: A Korean or English label is required.
lint.regex_anchor: Regex hints must be anchored ^…$ (validator only; not part of the grammar).
lint.regex_feature: Look-around / flags are not supported by the grammar.
lint.enum_empty: A choice field needs at least one option.
lint.enum_large: More than {{n}} options bloat the grammar.
lint.nesting: Tables and groups cannot be nested (no $ref in the grammar).
lint.children_empty: A table / group needs at least one column.
lint.children_ignored: A scalar field cannot have columns.
lint.options_ignored: Options only apply to choice fields.

mapping.title: Type → schema mapping
mapping.hint: The classifier's type enum is built from the enabled schemas' type slugs. Registered forms take precedence over samples.

nl.title: Create a schema from a description
nl.placeholder: e.g. Quotation: vendor, quote date, items (name · qty · unit price · amount), total, valid until
nl.hint: Review the generated fields in the grid, then save. A model must be loaded.

form.title: Register a form
form.hint: Finds the input items of a sample document (blank form or filled example) and creates a schema plus a document type. HWPX/DOCX forms are read from their table structure; PDFs / images use the vision model.

form.name_hint: Leave empty to use the document title / file name.
form.deriving: Looking for fields in the form…

form.no_docs: The library is empty. Import the form document first.
form.drop_hint: Drop a document to use it as the form sample

reclassify.banner: New type '{{name}}' added. Re-classify the {{count}} document(s) typed 'other'?

review.title: Review queue

review.edit_hint: Type the value as printed; amounts and dates are normalised on save.

scope.title: Document scope
scope.date_hint: By document date (import date when unknown)

name.title: File-name template

organize.only_reviewed_hint: When on, documents waiting for review are held back. The default lives in Settings › Processing.
organize.confirm_body: {{count}} file(s) will be moved / renamed. The operation is journaled and can be undone.

history.title: Batch history
history.hint: File moves, renames and deletions are journaled and can be undone per batch. File hashes are checked first; changed items are skipped.

target_hint.fields: Extracted field values (schema columns per type)

export.table_xlsx_exists: A file with this name already exists. Change the path or choose overwrite on the Export tab.

basis.mixed: by document date (import date when unknown)

generate.title: Generate document
generate.handoff: The generated draft is open. Check the preview and save it.

form.title: Request
form.format_placeholder: e.g. A4 official letter: recipient, cc, subject, body, attachments

editor.heading: Heading {{level}}

documents.no_checklist: No template: the checklist is empty. Assign a template to see the required documents.
documents.empty: The project has no documents yet. Add some from the library.
documents.add_hint: Adds library documents to the project; classified documents count towards the checklist.
documents.drop_hint: Drag library documents or files here to add them

rules.title: Consistency rules
rules.nl_label: Add a rule in natural language
rules.nl_placeholder: e.g. the supplier BRN of the tax invoice must equal the registration number of the business registration
rules.empty: No rules. Add one in natural language or create the project from a template.

relations.caption: Shared entities between documents
relations.empty: No shared entities (BRN, amounts, dates, names). Extract the documents and check again.

supplement.title: Supplement request
supplement.hint: Drafts a supplement request from the selected mismatch / missing findings; review and save it on the generate screen.
supplement.none: No mismatch / missing findings. Run the consistency check first.
supplement.ready: The supplement request draft is ready.
supplement.result_missing: The supplement request draft could not be loaded. You can open it from the drafts list on the document generator.
supplement.interrupted: {{reason}} You can retry it on the Jobs screen.

templates.title: Project templates
templates.hint: A template is a set of required document types and consistency rules. Built-ins are read-only; duplicate them to edit.
templates.name: Name
templates.select: Select a template or create one.
templates.readonly: Built-in templates cannot be edited. Duplicate one to edit it.

pick.title: Choose a project
pick.hint: Pick the project that receives the {{count}} dropped document(s).
pick.hint_files: Pick the project that receives the {{count}} dropped file(s).
pick.none: No projects yet. Create one first.

classify.button_hint: Suggests a project for documents that belong to none, from their title and content.
classify.title: Classify documents into projects
classify.hint: Each document's title, file name, vendor and text are compared with every project's name, keywords, intake number and documents. Review or change the suggestions; nothing is assigned until you apply.
classify.model_hint: Documents the rule scores cannot decide (up to 20) are put to the loaded model.
classify.model_unavailable: No model is loaded; rule scores only.
classify.no_projects: No projects yet. Create one and give it keywords first.
classify.empty: Nothing to classify (every document already belongs to a project).

dnd.nothing: Nothing to add (unsupported type or already present)
dnd.nav_hint: While dragging, rest on a menu entry to switch to that screen
